Decision recorded under U-E2-23 in the former plan (`e39551c9b0:migration-tracking/plans/kilo-v2-migration-plan.md`); marketplace epic #15307.

api:GET /kilocode/marketplace.note: Served by the typed kilocode.marketplace RPC `list` and `installed` methods (packages/schema/src/kilocode/marketplace.ts, handlers in packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/index.ts). v2 has no HTTP parity by design; skills and MCPs only, agent/plugin kinds are dropped with their content units. Round trip: packages/kilo-cli/test/marketplace.test.ts.

api:POST /kilocode/marketplace/install.note: Served by the `install` and `preview` RPC methods (packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/index.ts install/preview handlers over Installer.install). Skills and MCPs only; install intent is saved to the database before any file changes. Round trips: packages/kilo-cli/test/marketplace.test.ts, marketplace-oauth.test.ts.

api:POST /kilocode/marketplace/remove.note: Served by the `uninstall` RPC method (packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/index.ts uninstall handler over Installer.uninstall); modified or unowned resources are refused and shared OAuth sign-in is retained. Round trip: packages/kilo-cli/test/marketplace.test.ts.

module:packages/opencode/src/kilocode/ma.note: Catalog client ported as packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/kilo.ts make() plus list() in index.ts (YAML decode, per-item skip on decode failure, per-kind failures, TTL cache). Deliberate differences: v1 retries/KILO_MARKETPLACE_BASE_URL are replaced by the persisted-snapshot fallback and KiloServer.fromEnv; kebab display synthesis and JSON-only parsing are dropped because the Kilo catalog ships named YAML.

MCP companion skills are provisioned by Installer.install (packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/installer.ts) with atomic Skill.write promotion. The v1 receipt/token files are replaced by the ownership record in the server database (index.ts save/restore: skill ids, server names and content fingerprints; locations are derived from the current scope, so records survive moving a project). Tested by packages/kilo-plugin/test/marketplace.test.ts and marketplace-plugin.test.ts.

Scope paths are KiloConfigFiles candidates plus the roots/directory helpers in packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/index.ts; isSafeId is restored as Skill.safe in packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/skill.ts (reserved device names, trailing dot, double dot) and tested in marketplace.test.ts. The v1 worktree-depth plugin layout helpers are not needed without plugin content.

stageSkill and findEscapedPaths are ported as bounded Skill.extract/prepare/write in packages/kilo-plugin/src/marketplace/skill.ts (byte and entry caps, traversal and case-collision rejection, symlink-tree conflicts, atomic promotion, fingerprint-guarded trash). The v1 owner marker file is replaced by the ownership record in the server database plus fingerprint-equal adoption.

module:packages/kilo-vscode/src/commands.note: webview-ui/src/v2/auto-approve.tsx createAutoApprove and webview-ui/src/v2/auto-approve-policy.ts createAutoApproveController replace the host toggle controller: while active they reply "once" to each permission request, dedupe across the permission store and the pending sweep, retry a failed reply, and skip sandboxEscalation. src/chat.ts and src/protocol.ts persist the toggle in context.globalState with a default of off. Differences: persistence is global rather than the closest v1 config scope; the sweep covers the current location while new requests arrive on the server-global event stream; the controller runs in the retained webview instead of the extension host before the view is first opened. Window-independent auto-approve is a scoped follow-up.

module:packages/kilo-vscode/src/kilo-pro.note: webview-ui/src/v2/auto-approve.tsx replaces the v1 bridge: it requests the persisted state, listens for autoApproveStateLoaded, and persists toggles through the requestAutoApproveState/persistAutoApproveState messages in src/protocol.ts, handled by src/chat.ts. Replies use permission.reply({sessionID, requestID, decision: "once"}), so v1's SSE/session directory resolution is not needed.
